abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.text: A Rifleman that has not moved this turn rolls 1 extra attack die.

abilities.name: Way of the Blade
abilities.text: When a Guard attacks an adjacent hero, it rolls 1 extra attack die.

abilities.name: Harry
abilities.text: When an enemy figure leaves a hex next to a Prowler, the Prowler's passing strike is a full normal attack instead.

abilities.name: Reboot
abilities.text: When a Hunter is destroyed by an attack, roll a d20. On 17 or more it stands back up where it fell, with no wounds.

abilities.name: Reassemble
abilities.text: At the end of the Legion's turn, if any of its figures are destroyed, roll a d20. On 15 or more one of them returns, with no wounds, next to a Legion figure still standing.

abilities.name: Blood Surge
abilities.text: After a Raider's first normal attack in a turn, roll the d20. On 15 or more it may make one more normal attack this turn.

abilities.name: Life Tap
abilities.text: Instead of attacking, Morvane may drain an enemy figure up to 4 hexes away and in sight: roll 2 attack dice against it (it defends normally). Morvane heals 1 wound for each wound it takes.

abilities.name: Grave Blight
abilities.text: Special action instead of a normal attack. Range 4, in line of sight: roll 2 attack dice against the target and 1 attack die against every other figure next to it, friend or foe. Each defends normally.

abilities.name: Soul Reap
abilities.text: When Vorhal destroys a figure with an attack, remove 1 wound from Vorhal.

abilities.name: Grave Riposte
abilities.text: When Vorhal defends against an adjacent attacker and rolls more shields than it rolled skulls, the attacker takes 1 wound.

abilities.name: Constrict
abilities.text: Instead of attacking, Marrowcoil may coil around an adjacent Small or Medium enemy figure that is not unique and roll the d20. On 16 or more that figure is destroyed.

abilities.name: Grave Dread
abilities.text: When an enemy figure next to Marrowcoil attacks or uses a special action on its own turn, it rolls the d20 first. On 1 to 6 it loses its nerve and the attack is lost.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.text: A Knight that has moved this turn rolls 1 extra attack die when it attacks an adjacent enemy.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.text: A Huscarl rolls 1 extra defense die while another Huscarl stands next to it.

abilities.name: Spotter's Call
abilities.text: A Sunbound Archer may shoot at an enemy it cannot see if another friendly figure within 3 hexes of that enemy can see it. It rolls 1 fewer attack die for that shot.

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.text: Solenne flies: count her move in hexes straight to where she lands, ignoring terrain, height and figures on the way. Terrain only affects her where she lands, and she never takes falling damage.

abilities.name: Smite the Unholy
abilities.text: When Solenne attacks an Undead or Oni figure, she rolls 2 extra attack dice.

abilities.name: Wings of Refuge
abilities.text: When Solenne flies, she may carry one friendly Small or Medium single-hex figure from next to her and set it down next to where she lands. It takes no passing strikes.

abilities.name: Arc Lightning
abilities.text: Special action instead of a normal attack. Range 5, in line of sight: roll 3 attack dice against the target and 1 attack die against every other figure next to it, friend or foe. Each defends normally.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.text: Instead of moving normally, Orrin may vanish and reappear on a free hex up to 4 hexes away that he can see. That is his whole move: he takes no passing strikes, and nothing between matters.
